01Why now

Why this course, and why now

One person with AI can now do work that once needed a team, which lowers the cost of starting and raises the standard for what you offer. This course covers the fundamentals of building a business and a consulting practice, with AI as part of how you work.

02Outcomes

What you will be able to do

Shape an offer

Define who you serve, what problem you solve and why you.

Win customers

Sell and negotiate with confidence and a clear process.

Plan the business

Write a business plan with numbers you can defend.

Run lean with AI

Use AI to do more with a small team, and know its limits.

04The lab

Your offer and business plan

Build your offer, business plan and pitch for a business or consulting practice you could start. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Define the customer and the problem
  2. Write the offer and the price
  3. Write the sales process
  4. Build the financial plan
  5. Plan the first ninety days
  6. Write and practise the pitch

What the health check looks for

  • The offer names a specific customer and problem
  • The financial plan states its assumptions
  • The pitch fits in three minutes

05How you learn

The same method as every Intellica course

See it done

Every lesson starts with a finished example, so you know what good looks like.

Do it yourself

Early steps are mostly filled in. Later steps give you a template, then a blank page.

Check your work

Questions bring back what you learned on a schedule, and a health check tells you if your lab work holds up.

Stay current

Courses are built from current research, with sources you can open, and revised when the evidence changes.

The method follows published research on retrieval practice, worked examples and spaced review. Read the evidence and sources.

06Certificate

A certificate you can verify and share

When you meet the criteria you can claim a certificate with its own credential ID and a public page anyone can open to verify it. Add it to LinkedIn in one click, share it, or save it as a PDF.

To earn it

  1. Finish every lesson
  2. Complete every lab step and pass its health checks
  3. Answer at least 70% of the check questions correctly, on the first try or in review

What you get

  • A credential ID and a public page that confirms it
  • Add to LinkedIn in one click
  • Share on LinkedIn, X or Facebook, or copy the link
  • Save as a PDF

Intellica certificates show that you finished this course. They are not accredited qualifications and do not lead to any outside certification.
